effects: The vault pulls exactly `assets` DEGEN from the signer through the signer's allowance (`safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)` in ERC4626._deposit).
The vault mints mDEGEN shares to `receiver`. The share amount comes from the vault's total assets and supply after fee accrual, with no minimum in the calldata.
The DEGEN goes into Morpho Blue markets in the name of the vault (`_supplyMorpho`). This does not change what the signer gets.
formats.shown: Intent "Deposit", the DEGEN amount, a raw 'Share ticker' of mDEGEN, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: deposit does not show how many mDEGEN shares the receiver gets; the vault's exchange rate decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.deposit: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);` The calldata has no share amount and no minimum. The descriptor shows only the constant `$.metadata.constants.vaultTicker`.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The share amount comes from storage.

findings.title: deposit intent "Deposit" does not name the asset or the vault.
findings.evidence: descriptor deposit format: `"intent": "Deposit"`. The asset is DEGEN and the vault share is mDEGEN.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit DEGEN into Morpho Degen vault".

effects: The vault pulls DEGEN from the signer through the signer's allowance. The amount is `_convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, ..., Ceil)`, computed from storage, with no maximum in the calldata.
The vault mints exactly `shares` mDEGEN to `receiver`.
The DEGEN goes into Morpho Blue markets in the name of the vault.
formats.shown: Intent "Mint", 'Deposit asset' as the raw ticker DEGEN, the exact mDEGEN share amount, and the receiver of the shares.

findings.title: mint does not show how much DEGEN leaves the signer; the vault computes it from storage.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.mint: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil); _deposit(_msgSender(), receiver, assets, shares);` The descriptor field 'Deposit asset' shows only `$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker`. Only the signer's DEGEN allowance limits the pull.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor. The DEGEN amount comes from the vault's exchange rate.

findings.title: mint intent "Mint" does not say that the signer pays DEGEN for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor mint format: `"intent": "Mint"`. In ERC4626._deposit the vault calls `safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, address(this), assets)` on the signer.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Deposit DEGEN to mint mDEGEN shares".

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns mDEGEN shares from `owner`. The share amount is `_convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, ..., Ceil)`, computed from storage.
When the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the signer's mDEGEN allowance from `owner` by the share amount.
The vault sends exactly `assets` DEGEN to `receiver`.
formats.shown: Intent "Withdraw", 'Withdraw exactly' as the DEGEN amount, 'To' as the receiver, and 'Owner' as the share owner.

findings.title: withdraw does not show how many mDEGEN shares the owner burns; the vault's exchange rate decides it.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.withdraw: `shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Ceil);` then ERC4626._withdraw: `_burn(owner, shares);`. The calldata has no share amount or maximum.

findings.title: withdraw intent "Withdraw" does not name DEGEN or the vault.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Withdraw DEGEN from Morpho Degen vault".

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: The vault burns exactly `shares` mDEGEN from `owner`.
When the signer is not `owner`, the vault spends the signer's mDEGEN allowance from `owner` by `shares`.
The vault sends DEGEN to `receiver`. The amount is `_convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, ..., Floor)`, with no minimum in the calldata.
formats.shown: Intent "Redeem", the mDEGEN share amount, 'To' as the receiver, and 'Owner' as the share owner. Nothing names the asset the receiver gets.

findings.title: redeem does not name DEGEN as the asset the receiver gets; mint shows the ticker but redeem does not.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem → ERC4626._withdraw: `SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets);` with `_asset` = 0x4ed4…efed (DEGEN). The redeem format fields are only `shares`, `receiver` ('To') and `owner`. The mint format has a field `"value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"`.
findings.fix: Add a field `{"label": "Receive asset", "format": "raw", "value": "$.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker"}` and change the label of `receiver` to "Send DEGEN to".

findings.title: redeem does not show how much DEGEN the receiver gets, and there is no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorpho.redeem: `assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), newTotalAssets, Math.Rounding.Floor);`. The amount comes from storage. The calldata has no asset amount.

findings.title: redeem intent "Redeem" does not say that shares become DEGEN.
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Redeem mDEGEN shares for DEGEN".
